Maya Patel: Quick help — corporate card charge from CLOUDOPS*TOOLS posted as 'Software Vendor' (MCC 5734) but vendor portal invoice needs to be split between project and personal training. Charge on card statement = $412.50 (posted 2026-03-01). Receipt attached. Can finance split 60% to project code INF-42 and reimburse 40% to my personal card?
Diego Ramos: Do you have the vendor invoice and the original currency amount? need txn id for reconciliation.
Maya Patel: Yep. Vendor invoice link: https://vendor.cloudops.tools/invoices/INV-98765 (pdf). Original was EUR 370.00, FX hit the card as USD $412.50. Txn ID on statement: TXN-0xABC123. Receipt image uploaded to expense form.
expense-bot: New card charge detected: CARD-2027-455. Parsed: amount_usd=412.50, amount_local=EUR 370.00, merchant=CLOUDOPS*TOOLS, cardholder=Maya Patel. Please confirm coding or add allocation.
Nora Chen: Hi Maya — thanks. Two quick Qs: 1) confirm project code exactly (INF-42?) 2) is the 40% personal portion a reimbursable training expense or personal non-reimbursable? We need manager approval either way.
Maya Patel: Confirm project = INF-42. The 40% is for the "Advanced LLM Ops" course I took, reimbursable per policy. I paid on corp card accidentally so want 40% refunded to my personal card.
Evelyn Brooks: Approved — 60% to INF-42, 40% reimbursable to Maya's personal. :thumbsup:
Nora Chen: OK approved by manager. Two follow-ups: vendor invoice needs Redwood's VAT number and company address to accept project billing. Does the invoice show VAT line? If not we may need vendor to reissue. Also confirm which GL account for INF-42 — choose 6102 (SaaS subscriptions) or 6210 (training) for Maya's portion?
Maya Patel: Invoice attached is vendor portal invoice but it shows no VAT breakdown (they're EU but small). For GL: charge 60% to 6102 (SaaS) and 40% to 6210 (Training) for the reimbursement ledger. I'll ping vendor to request VAT-inclusive invoice to Redwood Inference (VAT GB999888777).
Nora Chen: Perfect. I'll process the split once we have either a VAT invoice or a vendor confirmation note. For now I'll create a pending journal: JE-2026-331 and allocate 60%/40% as placeholders. Expect payout to Maya's personal card in the next payroll cycle unless you prefer ACH — let me know.
Maya Patel: ACH would be better. My details are on the employee portal. Thanks!
Nora Chen: Noted. I'll update the expense record and post final once vendor responds. Posting current planned entries:
```
Journal JE-2026-331
Debit 6102 (SaaS) $247.50  (60%)
Debit 6210 (Training) $165.00 (40%) — reimb to Maya
Credit CorporateCard Clearing $412.50
```
Nora Chen: Leaving a flag to follow up on VAT; will mark as pending vendor reissue. Will update thread when transaction clears.
Diego Ramos: tagging accounting for any FX variance policy — we sometimes book FX gains/losses to 6540. Keep me posted.
expense-bot: Expense CARD-2027-455 status updated to PENDING_REALLOC (assigned JE-2026-331).
